diagnosis.summary: Payment-service is in a severe degraded state, with a 5xx error rate of 37.3% and p95 latency up roughly 499x from baseline. Order-service, which calls payment-service on every order, is reflecting that degradation with 41 dependency errors per minute and a 5xx error rate of 16.9%. The incident has persisted for 6 minutes.
diagnosis.root_cause: A failure active within the payment-service handler is the most likely root cause, producing extreme latency and a high error rate in payment-service that propagates into order-service's dependency calls and end-to-end responses.
evidence: Payment-service p95 latency rose from 4.5 ms to 2249.6 ms (approximately 499x), and p99 latency rose from 6.9 ms to 2249.8 ms (approximately 324x).
Payment-service error_rate_5xx is now 37.3%, up from a baseline of 0.

Order-service dependency_latency_ms_p95 rose from 22.1 ms to 2264.4 ms (approximately 102x), closely matching payment-service's current p95 latency of 2249.6 ms; dependency_latency_ms_mean rose from 16.2 ms to 851.3 ms (approximately 52x).
Order-service dependency_error_count is 41 per minute, up from a baseline of 0.
Order-service p95 latency rose from 25.1 ms to 2265.4 ms (approximately 90x), p99 from 30.0 ms to 2269.0 ms (approximately 76x), and error_rate_5xx reached 16.9% from a baseline of 0.
recommended_actions: Inspect payment-service CloudWatch Logs at /aws/lambda/anomalypulse-payment and check lambda_duration_ms_mean and lambda_duration_ms_p95 to identify what is failing or slow inside the payment handler.
Check payment-service lambda_throttle_count in CloudWatch to determine whether throttled invocations are contributing to the dependency_error_count on order-service.
Do not add retries to order-service's call to payment-service while payment-service is struggling, as each retry adds an additional invocation and extends wait time for clients.
If payment-service is found to be throttled, assign it reserved concurrency to protect its share of Lambda concurrency from other functions.
After each change, recheck dependency_error_count and order-service error_rate_5xx to confirm improvement.
